==Description==
The '''Cookie Guard''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a fast speed and a decent amount of health. It also had 40% defense.

==Appearance==
The '''Cookie Guard''' had pale skin. It had a brownish orange shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, dark brown pants and black shoes. It wore a brownish orange Christmas hat with a tilde emblem on it. It also wore a chestplate, protective face mask, shoulder-pads and gloves made from cookies, with lines of white frosting on them. Additionally, it wielded a fruit cookie sword.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this.
**These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively.
*You can use defense dropping towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] to decrease the defense of this enemy, allowing your towers to deal more damage.

==Trivia==
*The [[Guardian Elf]] unit from the [[Elf Camp]] is based on this enemy.
**Weirdly, in the trailer for the [[Violent Night Event]] the [[Guardian Elf]] appears guarding the [[Gatekeeper (Cold Ambush)|Gatekeeper]], despite the '''Cookie Guard''' being the enemy variant of the [[Guardian Elf]].
*Despite holding a sword, it cannot attack towers, making it purely cosmetic.
